# latching_food_box

Round 2: **TARGET NOT MET**. 3 dishware instances. Authoritative comparison: [photo, render and overlay](../review/latching_food_box_compare.jpg); [numerical report](../qa_report.json). Earlier reconstruction prose is retained in [Round 1 history](../review/round2_before/latching_food_box/notes.md).

## Evidence and shape

Same supplied metric OpenCV cameras, WORLD metres with +Z up; GLB uses +Y up. Metric scale is inherited from reconstruction, not a tape measure. Each instance keeps its measured pose, orientation, scale and provenance in `model.json`. Source photographs are motion blurred and some boundaries are occluded; typical manual boundary uncertainty is 8 source pixels.

| Frame | IoU | Photo visible W/H, px | Model visible W/H, px | RGB histogram distance |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| f2965 | 0.8791 | [563.0, 422.0] | [575.0, 458.0] | 0.1882 |
| f2979 | 0.8734 | [637.0, 487.0] | [645.0, 488.0] | 0.2014 |
| f2980 | 0.8729 | [648.0, 495.0] | [655.0, 494.0] | 0.1988 |

Visible extents are occlusion-limited measurements, not full product dimensions. Tiny disconnected mask fragments are excluded only from extent measurements; raw extents and all-pixel IoU remain in the report. Canonical visual bounds are `[[-0.10750000178813934, -0.08249999582767487, 0.0], [0.10750000178813934, 0.08249999582767487, 0.06499999761581421]]` metres. Shell/floor assumptions are `0.0032` / `0.003` metres.

## Changes

- Rounded rectangular shell contact bands follow wall taper; separate lid geometry and seal
- Matched open top/bottom storage bodies, smaller upper size and outward clear closure flaps; blue gasket separated from clips
- Replaced the incorrectly frosted, partly diffuse plastic with physical clear transmission at IOR 1.49 and 0.045 roughness so the open walls and blue lid seal remain visible
- Remeasured observed depth surfaces in three calibrated frames
- Re-fitted metric placement, scale, tilt and nesting spacing against fixed cameras
- Computed mass, COM and per-instance inertia from closed shell volumes and material densities

## Material, contact and physics

Empty canonical asset mass: **0.2415 kg**, from closed physical shell volumes and per-part densities. No manufacturer product identification or scale measurement is available. The stored ±30% range is a nominal engineering prior, not a confidence interval. Scale and unobserved wall-thickness uncertainty may be larger. Material: polypropylene; friction 0.3; restitution 0.05; fragile `False`. Per-instance masses, mass-weighted COM and inertia use each variant, scale and retained part state.

| Physical part | Density kg/m³ | Mass kg | Canonical COM m |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| body | 950 | 0.10537 | [-0.0, 0.0, 0.01949] |
| lid | 950 | 0.09425 | [-0.0, 0.0, 0.0635] |
| latch_0 | 950 | 0.01213 | [-0.0, -0.0795, 0.051] |
| latch_1 | 950 | 0.01213 | [0.0, 0.0795, 0.051] |
| latch_2 | 950 | 0.00882 | [-0.1045, -0.0, 0.051] |
| latch_3 | 950 | 0.00882 | [0.1045, -0.0, 0.051] |

54 convex contacts follow the floor, segmented thin walls, handles/stems and separate closure parts. They preserve vessel cavities; they are not a liquid boundary. Convexity, watertightness and open-axis checks passed. The individual upright 2-second Blender settling check passed. These checks do not certify assembled stacking, rack hanging, robot grasping, fracture, or friction accuracy.

Joints: `[{"name": "latch_0_hinge", "type": "revolute", "parent": "lid", "child": "latch_0", "axis": [-1, 0, 0], "origin": [0, -0.0795, 0.061], "range": [0, 1.7], "status": "Visible clip; hinge axis and range inferred, not demonstrated"}, {"name": "latch_1_hinge", "type": "revolute", "parent": "lid", "child": "latch_1", "axis": [1, 0, 0], "origin": [0, 0.0795, 0.061], "range": [0, 1.7], "status": "Visible clip; hinge axis and range inferred, not demonstrated"}, {"name": "latch_2_hinge", "type": "revolute", "parent": "lid", "child": "latch_2", "axis": [0, 1, 0], "origin": [-0.1045, 0, 0.061], "range": [0, 1.7], "status": "Visible clip; hinge axis and range inferred, not demonstrated"}, {"name": "latch_3_hinge", "type": "revolute", "parent": "lid", "child": "latch_3", "axis": [0, -1, 0], "origin": [0.1045, 0, 0.061], "range": [0, 1.7], "status": "Visible clip; hinge axis and range inferred, not demonstrated"}]`. Detachable parts: `["lid"]`. Clip axes and rest/open states are modeled; actuation and snap forces remain unmeasured.

## Appearance and reproducibility

Glass uses physical transmission, IOR 1.5 and thin inner/outer walls. Glaze and metal parameters are stored in `material_parameters`; they are material priors, not measured BRDFs. Photo rebakes and inferred generated details are documented in [texture provenance](../review/round2_texture_provenance.json). No source object image is inserted into a glass shader or review background. Bounded exposure/white-balance fitting is in-sample, using the same review frames. The offline renderer records actual wall times, sample count, resolution and denoising under `review/`.

Build this asset with `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -P build.py`. Run the set-level `round2_render.py -- latching_food_box`, `round2_physics.py`, and `round2_report.py` for calibrated reviews and metadata. `model.glb` is visual geometry; simulation importers must also read the JSON joints and compound collision files.

## Remaining

- Separate closure parts/contact and clip hinge directions match observed open/closed states; hinge ranges are inferred and snap force is unmeasured
- Appearance target A not reached: masked RGB histogram distance 0.196; environment, view-dependent reflections and unresolved surface detail remain
- Mass is a density/closed-shell estimate with nominal uncertainty (usually ±30%; ambiguous lower-shelf metal cup variants ±65%); product identity and wall thickness unmeasured
- No full assembled stack/rack dynamics, breakage or robot-grasp validation
